units.source_text: 秋好皇后所居的西南一区内，在原有的山上栽种浓色的红叶树，从远处导入清澄的泉水。

en.t: In the southwestern section where Empress Akikonomu lived, dark-colored maple trees were planted on the existing hill, and clear spring water was brought in from afar.

units.source_text: 欲使水声增大，建立许多岩石，使水流成瀑布——这就开辟成了广大的秋野。

en.t: To make the sound of the water louder, many rocks were set in place so that the current fell as a waterfall; in this way, a broad autumn field was opened up.

units.source_text: 此时正值秋天，秋花盛开，秋景之美，远胜于嵯峨大堰一带的山野。

en.t: It was just autumn then, and the autumn flowers were in full bloom; the beauty of the autumn scene far surpassed the hills and fields around the Great Weir at Saga.
